overview: Aerospace Engineering in Italy provides Indian students with advanced technical knowledge of aircraft design, spacecraft systems, aerodynamics, propulsion, flight mechanics, and space technologies. If you're a graduate engineer looking to specialize in aviation, satellite systems, aerospace structures, computational fluid dynamics, or space exploration technologies, then a Master's in Aerospace Engineering in Italy could be an attractive proposition.

Italy has a strong aerospace research and manufacturing industry, providing opportunities to study at technical universities and to participate in advanced engineering research. Aerospace engineering and related disciplines are offered by several institutions at undergraduate and postgraduate levels (the latter in English). Indian students can also explore scholarships and career options in aerospace manufacturing, aircraft systems, space technology, research and engineering consultancy sectors.

3. Top Italian Universities for Aerospace Engineering
1. Politecnico di Milano

Offers a 2-year Master's in Aeronautical Engineering taught in English. Students learn subjects like aerodynamics, aerospace structures, aircraft performance, flight dynamics and propulsion. The university also has a separate Master's in Space Engineering for students interested in satellites and space systems.
Official websites Aeronautical Engineering Space Engineering
2. Politecnico di Torino

Features a Master's in Aerospace Engineering with specialist areas in aerospace structures, propulsion systems, aeromechanics, aerogas dynamics and space engineering. The university states that the program language is Italian for the academic year 2026-27, so students should check their language eligibility before applying.
Official website Aerodynamics Engineering
3. Bologna University

It offers a two-year, 120-ECTS Master's in Aerospace Engineering , all courses taught in English at its Forlì campus. The program covers Aeronautics and Space curricula. The program mentions restricted admission. The program has 80 places for the 2026-27 academic year.
Program website: MSc Aerospace Engineering
4. How to Study Aerospace Engineering in Italy
Generally, Indian students who wish to pursue Masters in Aerospace Engineering in Italy must satisfy the following requirements:
Bachelor's degree: An accredited undergraduate degree in Aerospace Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or other relevant subject accepted by the university.
Academic background: Solid grounding in mathematics, physics, mechanics, fluid dynamics, materials science and engineering fundamentals.
Academic Performance: Fulfilll the minimum grade and academic assessment requirements of the university.
English proficiency: If the program is taught in English, you will need to present an accepted language certificate.
Italian proficiency: Fulfill the language requirements for programs taught in Italian.
Subject-credit requirements: Some universities may review previous coursework and require credits in certain engineering subjects.

Politecnico di Milano evaluates foreign-degree applicants on the basis of the suitability of their academic qualification and preparation. The University of Bologna also has specific program entrance requirements. Minimum criteria are required but do not guaranty admission.

7. Admission Procedure for Aerospace Engineering in Italy
Choose your university and course. Compare aeronautical engineering, space engineering, propulsion & other paths available.
Verify your eligibility. Verify that your bachelor's degree, fields of study and language skills fulfilll the admission requirements.
Organize your papers. Collect academic transcripts, degree certificates, language test results and other required documents.
Apply. Applicants are to apply through the university's official application portal before the deadline.
Complete academic assessment. Supplemental documents or full assessments will be requested as needed.
Accept your offer of admission. Please follow the university's instructions for enrollment and procedures for payment of tuition.
Fill out the pre-enrolment and visa formalities. Follow official requirements for international students and the Italian student visa process.
For official information on pre-enrolment please visit Universitaly. Check visa requirements and deadlines with relevant Italian consular authorities.
8. Aerospace Engineering Degree and Accreditation in Italy
In Italy a Master's in Aerospace Engineering generally lasts two years and is worth 120 ECTS credits. The university decides on the name of the degree, the curriculum and the language of instruction.

Students receive a comprehensive education in aerodynamics, flight mechanics, aircraft structures, propulsion, spacecraft and aerospace materials. Coursework differs depending on the program, but may include engineering simulations, laboratory work, design projects, research and a final thesis.

Graduates may be employed in aerospace and related industries, or pursue doctoral studies, provided they meet the applicable requirements. For some regulated professional activities, additional examinations, registration or authorization might be required. Students should check the rules for professional recognition in the country they intend to work in.
